svg.title: Dr John Snow's Soho Cholera Spot Investigation (September 1854)
svg.desc: Edexcel GCSE History cartographic spot map of the September 1854 Soho cholera outbreak investigated by Dr John Snow, showing stacked red death tally bars clustered around the Broad Street Water Pump (50%, 52%), the leaking cesspit at 40 Broad Street (45%, 57%), anomaly survivals at the Poland Street Workhouse (54%, 27%) and Lion Brewery (68%, 50%), and the Hampstead outlier case of Widow Susannah Eley (22%, 24%).

g.text: Leaking brick lining — 3 ft from well!
Had bottled Broad St pump water
delivered by cart · Proved water link!
